北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，注意防护，出门戴口罩，保护呼吸道哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Hazy in Beijing, wear a mask and protect your respiratory health!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云有点凉，早晚温差大，记得添衣保暖哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and a bit cool in Cixi, mind the temperature changes and dress warmly.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感舒适，记得带伞以防不时之需。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and comfortable. Keep an umbrella handy, just in case.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云偏热，体感 30℃，记得多补水，防晒要做好！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and warm, feels like 30℃. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云，体感 29℃ 暖和，别忘了多喝水，防晒哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and feels warm at 29℃. Remember to drink water and use sunscreen.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 19℃ 舒适。记得关注天气变化，合理穿衣。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy and comfortable at 19℃. Pay attention to weather changes and dress appropriately.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 18℃ 宜人，出门享受阳光好心情吧！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and pleasant at 18℃ in Nanjing. Go out and enjoy the good weather!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 27℃ 稍热，湿度适中，记得多补充水分。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and a bit warm at 27℃ in Chengdu. Stay hydrated.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗，体感 27℃ 暖和，紫外线强，做好防晒哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and warm at 27℃ in Wuhan. UV index is high, so protect your skin.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 24℃ 舒适，早晚微凉，记得添衣。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and comfortable at 24℃ in Xi'an. It might be cool in the morning/evening, so dress in layers.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗炎热，体感 31℃。记得多喝水，谨防中暑哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and hot at 31℃ in Chongqing. Drink plenty of water to avoid heatstroke!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨阴天，体感 9℃ 寒凉，风力 0级，注意防寒保暖哦。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and cold at 9℃ in Harbin. Remember to dress warmly.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 18℃ 凉爽，风力 3级，出门记得带件外套哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cool at 18℃ in Shenyang with 3级 winds. Don't forget a jacket when you go out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 22℃ 舒适，湿度较低，记得多喝水润燥。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and comfortable at 22℃ in Kunming. Low humidity, so stay hydrated!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 21℃，湿度 84% 较高，注意防潮哦。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and 21℃ in Xiamen with 84% humidity. Watch out for dampness!
厦门.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 12℃ 凉爽，湿度 89% 较高，出门带件外套。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and cool at 12℃ in Qingdao, with high humidity at 89%. Bring a jacket!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有雾，体感 10℃ 凉意，能见度低，出行请注意安全！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Foggy and cool at 10℃ in Dalian. Visibility is low, please travel safely!
